work: Migrated the hidden single-item Park to a published standalone destination for the combined alpine coaster and summer bobsleigh tracks. Integrated eight editorial descriptions, three visually inspected exact licensed photos, six current adult/child fare offers, the operator’s annual timetable through 2027, three access conditions, eight public locale routes and a Facebook post.
qualification: Operator FAQ confirms two tracks under one operator, site and per-person ticketing. A single StandaloneAttraction represents this dedicated toboggan destination. Controlled migration retired the hidden legacy Park and ParkItem without a duplicate public venue.
sourceLimitations: Operator price page says children aged 3–8 need accompaniment, while FAQ says 3–10; the current price page wording is encoded and the discrepancy is flagged for confirmation.
Operator FAQ says 24 December is closed while the annual timetable groups that date with ordinary November–December hours; verify holiday exceptions directly before travel.
Public holidays can use weekend hours, and extreme weather or technical issues can alter operations. The published normal seasonal rules do not encode specific holiday overrides.
